observations: Photo 0: top of a bare inline engine in a parts shop, four coil-on-plug ignition coils in a row, aluminium cam cover, yellow-topped dipstick and an 'ENGINE OIL' filler cap.
Photo 0: lettering cast on the cam cover is blurred and cannot be read; no brand badge or engine code is legible.
Photo 1: front of the same engine, alternator, idler pulley and crank pulley fitted; a stamped number on the timing cover is too blurred to read.
Both photos carry a dealer watermark (EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE, posted on Jiji); engine sits among other parts, not running, no gearbox shown.
Visible surfaces look clean with light surface grime, no obvious cracks or broken housings in view.
No photo of the engine number, displacement marking, sump, compression or a running clip.

identity.kind: inline 4 cylinder petrol engine (seller says Hyundai/Kia)
read_from: photo 0 four ignition coils show 4 cylinders; no brand or engine code legible in either photo

claims.evidence: No badge or engine code readable; cast text on cam cover in photo 0 is blurred.
Photo 0 shows four coil packs in a row on the cam cover.
Origin cannot be shown by photos; no shipping or customs paper shown.
No running clip or cold start video.
No odometer, donor car record or internal inspection shown.
Cover bolts and gasket lines not shown close up; outside looks undisturbed but proves nothing inside.

risks.risk: Exact engine code and displacement unknown (1.6, 2.0 and 2.4 Hyundai/Kia engines look alike and price very differently)
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the stamped engine number on the block and the cast lettering on the cam cover
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; identity must be read first

risks.risk: Engine does not run or knocks
risks.proof: Clip of the engine running on a test stand or in the donor car from cold start, with sound
risks.if_unproven: as not working, core value only

risks.risk: Internal wear, low compression or previously opened and rebuilt
risks.proof: Compression test reading on all four cylinders on video, plus close-up of cam cover and sump gasket lines

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillaries and sensors (alternator, injectors, wiring, ECU not shown)
risks.proof: Walk-around clip of all four sides, sump and underside
risks.if_unproven: as bare long block with what is visible only

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the stamped engine number/code on the block and the cast lettering on the cam cover
Video of the engine running from cold, with sound, showing no knock or smoke
Compression test readings on all four cylinders
Walk-around clip of all sides, sump and underside
Photo of any donor car VIN or import paper
response.reason: It is a 4 cylinder petrol engine, but the brand and engine code that set the price cannot be read in either photo, so not even a worst case comparable can be chosen until the engine number and cover lettering are shown.
